{{Top|leg}}
A '''transpond marker''' was a device that could be left behind to mark a specific location. The marker would send out signals that allowed the user to find the location again using a [[Transpond marker tracker|tracker]]. [[Gamgalon]], a [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] who ran [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] safaris as a cover for an [[Aleudrupe berry/Legends|aleudrupe berry]] harvesting business, used transpond markers in [[Gender/Legends|his]] operations. The safaris were used to mask the planting of the berries, and transpond markers were left at the planting sights to help [[Gamgalon]] and his organization find the crops again for harvesting.
